items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: They had 피shaw and Alfred Williams and Charlie Bocage on banjo. It was three good pieces they had.

ctx.x: Well, I think, what about the Big 25 in your time? Was there music there or just the hangout for musicians and what happened?
No, they had music. They mostly had three, four pieces there. It was three good man's that they had. They had 피shaw and Alfred Williams and Charlie Bocage on banjo. It was three good pieces they had.
Where was the band? Was it in the main room or was it in the back room?
